description: This file defines the interface for the IGraphicBufferProducer class, which is part of the Android graphics system. It declares methods for buffer management, connection handling, and buffer queue operations used in graphics buffer production and consumption, including batching and parcelable support.

classes.name: IGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: Interface for producing graphics buffers, including methods for buffer request, queue, detach, connect, disconnect, and batch operations.

classes.name: BnGraphicBufferProducer
classes.description: Binder interface class for IGraphicBufferProducer, handling transaction dispatch.

methods.name: requestBuffer
methods.description: Requests a new buffer for a given slot.

methods.name: setMaxDequeuedBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be dequeued.

methods.name: setAsyncMode
methods.description: Enables or disables asynchronous buffer queueing.

methods.name: dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Requests a new buffer slot for the client to use.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Removes ownership of a buffer in a slot.

methods.name: detachNextBuffer
methods.description: Detaches the oldest available buffer that contains a GraphicBuffer.

methods.name: attachBuffer
methods.description: Transfers ownership of a buffer to the buffer queue.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Indicates that the client has finished filling a buffer and queues it.

methods.name: cancelBuffer
methods.description: Cancels a buffer, returning ownership to the server.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Retrieves information about the buffer queue.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a client API to the buffer producer.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a client API from the buffer producer.

methods.name: setSidebandStream
methods.description: Attaches a sideband buffer stream.

methods.name: allocateBuffers
methods.description: Allocates buffers with specified dimensions and format.

methods.name: allowAllocation
methods.description: Restricts buffer allocation to existing buffers.

methods.name: setGenerationNumber
methods.description: Sets the generation number of the buffer queue.

methods.name: getConsumerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the connected consumer.

methods.name: setSharedBufferMode
methods.description: Enables or disables shared buffer mode.

methods.name: setAutoRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-refresh mode.

methods.name: setDequeueTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for dequeueBuffer.

methods.name: getLastQueuedBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the last queued buffer and associated fence.

methods.name: getFrameTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves frame timestamp information.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the buffer queue.

methods.name: getConsumerUsage
methods.description: Returns the consumer usage flags.

methods.name: setAutoPrerotation
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-prerotation at buffer allocation.

methods.name: requestBuffers
methods.description: Batched request for multiple buffers.

methods.name: dequeueBuffers
methods.description: Batched dequeue buffer operation.

methods.name: detachBuffers
methods.description: Batched detach buffer operation.

methods.name: attachBuffers
methods.description: Batched attach buffer operation.

methods.name: queueBuffers
methods.description: Batched queue buffer operation.

methods.name: cancelBuffers
methods.description: Batched cancel buffer operation.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Batched query operation.
